transcript.text: Alright everyone, before I commit to anything for Saturday evening, I need to hear from each of you. Rina, I know you're organizing a rooftop party at Riverside Plaza and want me to DJ. But I need the full picture — what's the offer on payment, what time does it start and end, what's the setup situation up there, and is there anything else I should know before I say yes? Anyone else in the room, if you've got details about scheduling, setup, or anything relevant, lay it out now.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My exact offer is a 45-minute DJ set beginning at 20:00 on Saturday for $180 and two meal vouchers.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Before you commit to Saturday, Jo, I should let you know about another offer on the table. The owner of Cedar Cafe offered you $240 for a 60-minute set on Sunday at 17:00 with no meal vouchers. I heard the offer directly during an afternoon booking inquiry. Just wanted to put that out there so you have the full picture.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I inspected the rooftop power and sound area at Riverside Plaza. The setup must use the venue's battery PA, must not use a subwoofer, and must include a soundcheck at 19:30. Jo, you'll want to factor that in before committing.
transcript.speaker: A4
